recentItems.title: Mystery paralysis leaves doctors searching for answers - BBC
recentItems.description:
A terrified teenager arrives at Southmead Hospital with a possible spinal injury after being thrown from a horse. 

But after examining her, doctors are left searching for answers. 

#Emergency247 #Hospital #NHS #Documentary  

Emergency 24/7: Embedded inside the busy Southmead Hospital, a Major Trauma Centre in Bristol, this series reveals the everyday pressures, and complex teamwork, required to keep the Emergency Department running. It follows staff as they look after patients from diagnosis through to their treatment, encountering everything from car crash amputations, stabbings and third-degree burns.
